revisionReason: Authoritative representative Unity asset evidence now exists. The former READY_FOR_ASSET_EVIDENCE checkpoint remains historical pre-evidence state and must no longer block Stage 3-3.

authorityPolicy.modelResourceMapping: explicit ConfigDataModelSkinResourceInfo mapping preserved by evidence
authorityPolicy.bundleResolution: exact authoritative runtime path or exact bundle entry evidence
authorityPolicy.supportingStaticRawBytes: allowed as supporting provenance but not as a substitute for authoritative Unity path resolution

requiredProof.static: Each representative frozen sourceImagePath has authoritative Unity path evidence.
requiredProof.spine: Each representative frozen sourceSpinePath has authoritative Unity path evidence.
requiredProof.model: All seven representative skinResourceId values map explicitly to model Prefab paths and are resolved as authoritative bundle entries.
requiredProof.boundary: No ownership/sourceOrder recomputation, fuzzy matching, numeric ID arithmetic, inferred bundle membership, or cross-root fallback.

completionPolicy.bulkClaim: Representative completion does not claim final resolution for all 540 Skin records.

stage33Handoff.purpose: Expand the frozen representative resolution rules to exact bulk asset resolution without reopening Skin identity/relation semantics.
bulkRules: reuse Stage 3-1 frozen locators and model resource IDs
use lightweight ConfigDataModelSkinResourceInfo index instead of rereading large raw ConfigData
do not prefer begin/current bundle by naming alone
do not extrapolate partial scan results
do not claim 540-Skin bulk completion until all candidate coverage is resolved or explicitly classified

prohibitedInference: asset existence or resolution success may not define release status
asset filename/path may not redefine heroId or sourceOrder
name similarity may not establish asset identity
numeric overlap may not establish model-resource semantics
begin/current bundle membership may not be inferred from filename
partial bulk scan results may not be extrapolated to unscanned candidates
release/localization/acquisition enrichment is outside this completion contract
